<p style="text-align:center">Surf and stay with like-minded people. Choose a room in one of our <strong>three surf houses</strong> – or a <strong>private flat or villa</strong> if you travel as a family or group. Everything is a short walk from the surf school, the beach and the village.</p>

<section class="rs-vs rs-tW" id="which"><div class="rs-w rs-vg"><div class="rs-vc " style="--w:12"><div class="rs-prose ">
<h2>Which one is right for you</h2>
<p style="text-align:left">Three different things, and the difference is less about comfort than about how you want your week to feel. A surf house puts you in the middle of everyone else who came to surf. A flat or a bungalow gives you a door you can close.</p>
<div style="overflow-x:auto">
<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse" class="rs-tbl rs-tbl--wide">
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align:left;border-bottom:2px solid #e8332a">Where</th>
<th style="text-align:left;border-bottom:2px solid #e8332a">Who it suits</th>
<th style="text-align:left;border-bottom:2px solid #e8332a">How it is booked</th>
<th style="text-align:left;border-bottom:2px solid #e8332a" class="rs-nw">Minimum</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;vertical-align:top"><strong>Room in a surf house</strong></td>
<td style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;vertical-align:top" data-label="Who it suits">Solo travellers and anyone who wants company at breakfast</td>
<td style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;vertical-align:top" data-label="How it is booked">Inside a Surf Camp or Kite Camp package, lessons included</td>
<td style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;vertical-align:top" class="rs-nw" data-label="Minimum">3 nights</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;vertical-align:top"><strong>Flat in the village</strong></td>
<td style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;vertical-align:top" data-label="Who it suits">Couples and families who want their own kitchen and their own evening</td>
<td style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;vertical-align:top" data-label="How it is booked">On its own, by email or WhatsApp &ndash; with or without lessons</td>
<td style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;vertical-align:top" class="rs-nw" data-label="Minimum">3 nights</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;vertical-align:top"><strong>Bungalow</strong></td>
<td style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;vertical-align:top" data-label="Who it suits">Groups of up to four who want quiet and space</td>
<td style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;vertical-align:top" data-label="How it is booked">Online: pick your dates and see the price straight away; lessons separately, if you like</td>
<td style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;vertical-align:top" class="rs-nw" data-label="Minimum">3 nights</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<p style="text-align:left">All three are a short walk or a short drive from the same beach, and everyone gets the same 10% off equipment rental in our shop for the length of the stay.</p>
</div></div></div></section><section class="rs-vs rs-tS"><div class="rs-w rs-vg"><div class="rs-vc " style="--w:12"><div class="rs-prose ">
<h2>What you get wherever you stay</h2>
<div style="overflow-x:auto">
<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;vertical-align:top" width="28%"><strong>In every place</strong></td>
<td style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;vertical-align:top">Free high&ndash;speed Wi&ndash;Fi, a fully equipped kitchen, bed linen, two towels per person for shower and hands, shampoo, shower gel and a hairdryer. Bring your own beach towel.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;vertical-align:top" width="28%"><strong>Cleaning</strong></td>
<td style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;vertical-align:top">Daily in the surf houses. Flats and bungalows are cleaned between stays.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;vertical-align:top" width="28%"><strong>No air conditioning</strong></td>
<td style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;vertical-align:top">There are fans instead. Famara gets a sea breeze almost every day of the year, which is why nobody here has ever really needed one.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;vertical-align:top" width="28%"><strong>Board storage</strong></td>
<td style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;vertical-align:top">Every place has somewhere to leave boards and hang wetsuits, so nothing wet comes into the bedroom.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;vertical-align:top" width="28%"><strong>Never a dormitory</strong></td>
<td style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;vertical-align:top">Every room we let is private. If you booked a bed in a shared room somewhere else, that is not us.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div></div></div></section><section class="rs-vs rs-tW"><div class="rs-w rs-vg"><div class="rs-vc " style="--w:12"><div class="rs-prose ">
<h2>Arriving and leaving</h2>
<p style="text-align:left">Check&ndash;in is from 14:00 and check&ndash;out by 11:00. Late flights are normal here and not a problem: we email you an access code before you travel, so you can let yourself in at two in the morning without anybody waiting up.</p>
<p style="text-align:left">The minimum stay is three nights everywhere. In practice that means four days on the island and two surfing days, because there are no lessons on the day you arrive or the day you leave.</p>
<p style="text-align:left">Coming as a group of more than eight? We combine two houses that sit close to each other. Write to us with dates and numbers rather than booking online, and we will put it together.</p>
</div></div></div></section><section class="rs-vs rs-faqx rs-section rs-faq rs-tS" id="faq-accommodation"><div class="rs-w rs-faqx__g"><div class="rs-faqx__l"><div class="rs-vc " style="--w:12"><h2 class="rs-vh rs-c ">Accommodation in Famara — frequently asked questions</h2><div class="rs-vraw "><script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"What types of accommodation in Famara does Red Star Surf offer?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"We have three options, all in Caleta de Famara: 1) Surf Houses – Casa del Mar, Casa 55 and Casa del Sol – with private double or twin rooms, booked as part of the Surf Camp or Kite Camp packages. <p>We have three options, all in Caleta de Famara: 1) Surf Houses – Casa del Mar, Casa 55 and Casa del Sol – with private double or twin rooms, booked as part of the Surf Camp or Kite Camp packages. Ideal for solo travellers, couples and groups. 2) Two private bungalows by Famara beach, for up to 4 people, booked as accommodation only (minimum 3 nights), to which you can add lessons, yoga, massage or rental. 3) Villas and apartments with 2–3 bedrooms for families and groups, on request by email. All options include free Wi-Fi and an equipped kitchen.</p>
</div></details><details class="rs-faqi"><summary>Is your accommodation close to the beach and the surf school?</summary><div class="rs-faqi__a"></p>
<p>Yes. The Surf Houses are in the village: Casa del Mar just 50 metres from Famara beach, Casa del Sol 100 metres from the surf shop and Casa 55 200 metres from the sea. The bungalows are by Famara beach, about 2 km from the village and the school; for them we recommend having a car.</p>
</div></details><details class="rs-faqi"><summary>How can I book accommodation in Famara that also includes surf lessons?</summary><div class="rs-faqi__a"></p>
<p>The easiest way is to book one of our Surf Camp packages at <a href="https://bookings.redstarsurf.com/en/category/surf-camp-packages" target="_blank" rel="noopener">bookings.redstarsurf.com</a>. They combine Surf House accommodation and surf lessons in one pack: from €229 for 3 nights (Surf Camp Easy, 2 h of lessons a day) or from €265 (Performance Surf Camp, 4 h a day with video analysis). You can also book a bungalow and add the lessons you want. If you have specific needs (family, particular dates, a group), contact us by phone (+34 928 528 808), WhatsApp (+34 648 745 447) or email (info@redstarsurf.com).</p>
</div></details><details class="rs-faqi"><summary>Does your accommodation have free Wi-Fi?</summary><div class="rs-faqi__a"></p>
<p>Yes. All our Surf Houses and bungalows have free Wi-Fi. In the Surf Houses, Wi-Fi is available both in the rooms and in the common areas.</p>
</div></details><details class="rs-faqi"><summary>What accommodation options do you have in Famara for groups or families?</summary><div class="rs-faqi__a"></p>
<p>For families of up to 4 people we recommend our bungalows by the beach: two bedrooms and a full kitchen. For larger families or groups, we have villas with 2–3 bedrooms (ask by email) and we can combine several rooms in the Surf Houses. For babies we can provide a cot free of charge on request. If you are coming as a family, get in touch and tell us what you need, and we will find the best option.</p>
</div></details><details class="rs-faqi"><summary>Do you offer private rooms in your Famara accommodation?</summary><div class="rs-faqi__a"></p>
<p>Yes. All the rooms in our Surf Houses are private: double or twin rooms that can be booked by one person or by a couple. There are no shared dormitory rooms. One of the rooms in Casa 55 even has a private bathroom. Bathrooms and the kitchen are shared among the guests of the same house, but the rooms are completely private.</p>
</div></details><details class="rs-faqi"><summary>What facilities do the Surf Houses have for a comfortable, practical stay in Famara?</summary><div class="rs-faqi__a"></p>
<p>Our Surf Houses include: private rooms, several bathrooms with shower, a fully equipped kitchen (fridge, hob, utensils), a common living room with TV, board games and sofa, a terrace or patio with sea or mountain views, free Wi-Fi throughout the house, an outdoor area to store boards and dry wetsuits, sheets and towels, and daily cleaning. There is no air conditioning, but in Famara you hardly ever need it: the ocean breeze keeps the houses cool practically all year (there are maybe 5 genuinely hot days a year – fans are available). The houses are also decorated in an authentic surf style.</p>
</div></details><details class="rs-faqi"><summary>Does your accommodation have space to store boards and surf gear?</summary><div class="rs-faqi__a"></p>
<p>Yes. All our Surf Houses have a dedicated area for surf gear: board racks and space to hang and dry wetsuits, swimwear and rash vests. The bungalows also have room to store gear; let us know when you book if you are bringing a lot of equipment.</p>
</div></details><details class="rs-faqi"><summary>Does the accommodation include access to fully equipped kitchens?</summary><div class="rs-faqi__a"></p>
<p>Yes. All the Surf Houses and bungalows have a fully equipped kitchen: fridge, ceramic hob or gas cooker, microwave, cooking utensils, crockery and cutlery. This lets you cook your own meals if you prefer, which is very handy if you follow a specific diet or want to save on eating out. That said, Famara has excellent restaurants and tapas bars a few minutes&#8217; walk away, at very reasonable prices.</p>
</div></details><details class="rs-faqi"><summary>Do I need a hire car if I stay in your accommodation?</summary><div class="rs-faqi__a"></p>
<p>In the Surf Houses you don&#8217;t: the beach, the surf school, the shop, the restaurants and the village supermarkets are less than 10 minutes&#8217; walk away. In the bungalows, about 2 km from the village, we recommend a car. If you book a 4-hour surf course and you are staying outside Famara, we pick you up at your hotel (Arrecife, Costa Teguise, Puerto del Carmen or the north of the island). To explore the island (Timanfaya, Jameos del Agua, the southern beaches, etc.), a hire car is very handy: we work with a trusted company that can deliver the car to our shop and collect it at the airport at the end. To get here from the airport, a taxi is the most comfortable option (about 25–35 minutes, €35–40).</p>
</div></details></div></div></section><br />
<section class="rs-vs rs-endcta"><div class="rs-w rs-vg"><div class="rs-vc " style="--w:12"><h2 class="rs-vh rs-c ">Surf Camp = accommodation + surf lessons</h2><div class="rs-prose ">
<p style="text-align:center">A room in a surf house comes as part of a <a href="https://www.redstarsurf.com/surfcamp/">Surf Camp package</a>: bed, lessons 5 days a week, board and wetsuit, from 229 &euro; for three nights. A flat or a bungalow is booked on its own, with or without lessons. Questions? Check our <a href="https://www.redstarsurf.com/frequently-asked-questions/">FAQ</a> or <a href="https://www.redstarsurf.com/contact-redstarsurf-lanzarote/">contact us</a>.</p>
</div><div class="rs-vbtn rs-c"><a class="rs-btn rs-btn--red" href="https://bookings.redstarsurf.com/en/category/surf-camp-packages" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Book a Surf Camp package</a></div></div></div></section><section class="rs-vs rs-tW"><div class="rs-w rs-vg"><div class="rs-vc " style="--w:12"><div class="rs-prose ">
